business_problem: process growing volumes of connected-vehicle telemetry and connectivity data quickly enough to support global mobile, satellite, and ISP operations without increasing cost.
solution_summary: Cubic³ uses Snowflake on Snowflake to process growing volumes of connected-vehicle telemetry and connectivity data quickly enough to support global mobile, satellite, and isp operations without increasing cost. Vehicle, network, and connectivity data from mobile, satellite, and ISP ecosystems are consolidated in Snowflake for global analytics. The platform replaces slower legacy processing paths so Cubic³ can run much larger telecom and IoT workloads without increasing its unit cost. Operations and business teams use the fresher analytics to manage connected-vehicle services, remove regional connectivity bottlenecks, and scale support for new vehicles and markets. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and downstream access on one governed platform reduces data copying, simplifies operations, and gives teams a single trusted operating view for analytics and AI. business_outcome: Cubic³ cut processing time from five days to one hour, handled 10x more data for the same cost, and supported connectivity operations for 25 million vehicles in more than 200 countries.
